fixture_changes: Ettool alone did not disable QUIC UDP_SEGMENT batching. Initial off/auto loss comparisons had unequal actual packet loss and were discarded. All rows here disable socket GSO as well as device offloads; repository fix a797059.

An experiment-local hook applies clsact egress u32 UDP tc police at 50mbit with a 32 KiB bucket on both endpoints, independently of the 10ms netem delay. This is genuine token-bucket policing, not a rate-limited queue.
Experiment-local step10 and step50 schedule profiles preserve 10ms delay while changing both direction rates at 15/30 seconds.

The old fixture truncated separate iperf-server.json at 400 lines. Receiver totals and phase intervals here come from complete server_output_json in iperf-client.json. Repository fix 93b5f35 preserves complete standalone JSON; verified with a 711-line completed result. Pacing diagnostics use the fixed capture.

All image variants use fixed git archives. The window and pacing diagnostics overlay only the recorded single-change patch, not arbitrary working-tree state. Fixed diagnostic builds use -buildvcs=false to avoid an exported tree inheriting a parent checkout's revision.

Discarded setup failures: FEC fixture had mismatched copied endpoint addresses before its first timed trial; pacing fixture initially requested a subnet already occupied by another test and Docker rejected it. Both were corrected before measurement; no failed setup is counted as a trial.

metric_definitions.goodput_mbit: receiver application TCP bytes per second from iperf sum_received, decimal Mbit/s
metric_definitions.parity_over_wire_datagrams_pct: sent FEC parity shards divided by all wire datagrams, not bytes; partial-group parity/data is reported separately and must not be mistaken for total overhead
metric_definitions.fec_unrecovered: receiver FEC source frames still missing; off-mode zero means no FEC measurement, not zero link loss
metric_definitions.steady_pacing_mbit_mean: mean controller pacing target after the first 5 seconds; not the average actual wire transmit rate
metric_definitions.longest_stall_s: longest contiguous zero-delivery interval in 250 ms iperf client intervals, not proof of an equivalent tunnel disconnection
metric_definitions.qdisc_dropped_a: forward endpoint netem counter; inspect separately from clsact policer counter
metric_definitions.send_queue_drops: bounded local send-queue overflow, distinct from network impairment and from QUIC receive-queue overflow

uncertainty: Most comparisons have n=2, and diagnostic random/clean/step have n=1. No confidence intervals or universal percentage improvement are claimed.

Kernel random-loss sequences were not seeded or replayed. Actual drop counts and workload packet counts differ between trials, especially for bursts. Compare useful delivery, measured drop counters and denominators; absolute FEC residual counts alone are misleading.
Short synthetic path tests do not establish multi-day stability, real ISP policy identification, or behavior on all RTTs and bucket sizes.

Pacing diagnostics are not production policy. A lower fixed gain can induce a higher estimated bandwidth, so the actual pacing target need not decrease monotonically. Bandwidth increases must be tested separately from policing.
